question: Should `repair_failed` become a terminal automerge outcome when the linked repair workflow fails, with direct best-effort reporting from the workflow and scheduled reconciliation as fallback?
rationale: The patch changes the meaning and denominator of automerge session telemetry; the implementation is focused, but accepting that operational contract requires maintainer intent beyond ordinary static review.

options.title: Confirm and merge after runtime validation
options.body: Accept the new terminal outcome after reviewing a failed-run and successful-requeue validation that demonstrates only the intended session is terminalized.

options.title: Keep scheduled reconciliation only
options.body: Retain the seven-day reconciliation fallback but omit direct workflow reporting if maintainers prefer to avoid additional telemetry writes in the repair workflow.

recommendation.title: Confirm and merge after runtime validation
recommendation.body: Accept the new terminal outcome after reviewing a failed-run and successful-requeue validation that demonstrates only the intended session is terminalized.
